title: Search a 2D Matrix
keyIdea: Rows are sorted and each row starts after the previous one ends, so the matrix read row by row is one sorted list. Binary search indices 0 … n·m − 1 and map an index to a cell with row = mid / m, col = mid % m.

approaches.name: Two binary searches: row, then column
approaches.idea: Find the last row whose first value ≤ target, then binary search that row.
approaches.why: Two binary searches; log n + log m = log(n·m).

approaches.name: One binary search on the flattened index
approaches.idea: s = 0, e = n·m − 1; mid → (mid / m, mid % m); compare and halve.
approaches.why: Standard binary search over n·m positions, with O(1) index → cell conversion.
